name: Moondream Parakeet Redux (1.58-bit Parakeet TDT 0.6B v3)

lineage.how_derived: every encoder weight ternary (-1, 0, +1); same architecture and tokenizer (card)
lineage.family: Parakeet (sibling: moondream/parakeet-ultra, full precision, see parakeet-ultra record)

purpose: Make Parakeet v3 run fast on CPUs and Apple GPUs: 178 MB, 113x real time on eight x86 cores with the vendor's Photon runtime (card).

license.name: CC-BY-4.0 (card tag)
license.notes: Card front matter says cc-by-4.0; the repo has no LICENSE file (404). Licence text not read.

architecture.kind: FastConformer-TDT, encoder weights ternary with group size 128 (config ternary_group_size 128)

variants.notes: 178 MB per card; read by the Photon runtime (AVX-512 VNNI, NEON, Metal); also community conversions (Core ML, LiteRT)

pc-12gb.notes: tiny model, fits every class with room for a resident LLM

pc-16gb.notes: tiny model, fits every class with room for a resident LLM

pc-24gb.notes: tiny model, fits every class with room for a resident LLM

pc-32gb.notes: tiny model, fits every class with room for a resident LLM

mac-16-24gb.notes: tiny model, fits every class with room for a resident LLM

mac-32gb.notes: tiny model, fits every class with room for a resident LLM

mac-64gb+.notes: tiny model, fits every class with room for a resident LLM

strengths: 178 MB, 113x real time on 8 CPU cores (vendor, Photon)
better than v3 on FLEURS and TED-LIUM long-form
weaknesses: worse in noise (9.04 vs 6.72) and on business speech (6.96 vs 6.15), vendor table
soft.maturity: 322 likes and 8.9k downloads within two months; the Moondream vision-model team.

tona_fit.reason: A ternary build only pays off where CPU or RAM is scarce; every Tona class fits the full 0.6B model. Revisit if a CPU-only or very small profile appears.
blockers: Photon runtime only, no Tona audio module

sources.note: README with comparison table, config.json, HF API

open_questions: Release post at moondream.ai not read
